title: Large personal Amiga library, Atari ST and Acorn discovery
summary: Personally screen 236 candidate URLs and add 29 projects, with two empty/README-only exclusions and one binary-database inspection deferral.
notes: Root assistant performed all discovery and main-branch publication without a worker, PR or new branch. Five fresh searches emphasized Amiga libraries, ST utilities, DOS research, Spectrum disassembly and Acorn tools. Each promoted root has primary documentation and concrete implementation evidence. Archived/mirrored lineages and hardware-specific libraries remain explicit; Pi4 Emu68 and Maggie/68080 requirements are not stock-Amiga compatibility. Native libraries, reusable wrappers, historical maintenance, host format tools and game research are separated. AI attribution is based only on explicit credits: ChatGPT function assistance, Claude co-authorship, and unnamed-LLM README generation (not inferred code authorship). No upstream library, driver, ROM, disk writer, bootblock, network service or firmware was executed. Immutable links preserve large or legacy-encoded files when inline proof text is not lossless. No independently verified runtime/build or universal semantic-completeness claim is made.

sources.reason: Shared PCI enumeration, configuration, DMA and interrupt API with multiple bridge wrappers; library initialization and documented platform split inspected.
Native Amiga library discovers and manages Raspberry Pi4 GIC-400 interrupts through Emu68 device-tree and shared MMIO helpers.
Library converts bitplane/chunky/RGB screen representations, palette modes and display geometry for Amiga-format graphics.
Blitz Basic statement/function wrapper for Frank Wille’s PTPlayer6.4, exposing MOD playback and effects with bank/address variants.
Integrated depacker source collection and build/test harness includes LZ4, RNC, Shrinkler, Cranker and other formats.
Shared/static rendering library handles texture-mapped geometry, clipping, buffers and lighting for the Maggie chipset.
Self-contained CD32 helper library offers8-bit framebuffer, PCM/MOD/CDDA, blitter and basic CDXL/input paths.
Graphics-card system with native board drivers and implementations of cybergraphics.library/Picasso96API; inspected separate driver-loader process mechanism.
bsdsocket-style API marshals requests through message and parallel-block transport components; real library/server/device sources present.
Amiga bsdsocket library proxies requests over A314 to a Pi service, with protocol framing and optional control tools.
Historical identify.library source with expansion IDs, system parameters, alerts/function names and CLI/ARexx support.
Shared partition scanner publishes partition.resource entries and supports separate cold-boot and DOS-time automount paths.
Static ELF support library supplies classic Exec, graphics, timer, commodities and hook functions for GCC workflows.
Maintenance of the classic39.x asynchronous file-I/O library with double buffering, SDK/startup refactoring and API tests.
FreeType-based RastPort TrueType rendering with glyph cache and updated classic library/test build.
Tiered shared-library HTTP client offers streaming handles, transport, cookies/proxies and selectable AmiSSL/AmiTLS backends.
Native AVL/red-black ordered-map library with callback-controlled memory/comparison and shared API.
Shared conversion library includes1–8-plane, interleaved and delta/writeback paths, with CPU-specific assembly and optional Akiko handling.
SANA-II based IPX networking source and examples support historical cross-platform LAN-game integration.
Devpac source synchronizes Dallas RTC with TOS and supplies resident Y2K correction in AUTO/boot-sector forms.
Font inspection/proportional font generation and IMG/PNG conversion, including newer Swift format implementation and palette variants.
GEM utility parses ST image geometry and formats/writes tracks through native Atari routines.
SDL2 source decodes320×200 planar Neochrome pixels and palette, displays them and can save a BMP screenshot.
Documents a small DOS COM cryptor’s unpacked algorithm and supplies matching high-level encryption/decryption code and tests.
Evidence-linked analysis of episode-one shareware2.0 maps/images/audio/UI and executable organization, with reproducible extractors.
Native cassette-interface routines exchange bytes, screen data and key/touch events with modern host/audio tools.
Rust DFS catalogue/extraction routines plus older C utilities and BASIC detokenizer source.
Qt disc-image editor covers old-map ADFS, DFS, PC FAT and DOS Plus, with metadata-preserving cross-tool drag/drop specification.
Host Huffman/run-length/distance-pair compression packages data with native decompression and ROM headers.
GitHub tree API reports an empty repository; no device-tree implementation is available here.
Only a short README announces the Lotus decompressor. No parser/source or released tool artifact is present.

Tree includes a CLKDRV Binary Ninja database and original driver utilities, but no text analysis/export. Inspect the database in a supported read-only analysis environment or obtain exported findings before describing the actual reverse-engineering contribution; binary presence alone does not establish it.
